description: This Java source file defines the 'ThingMongoEventAdapter' class, which implements an event adapter for persisting and retrieving 'Event' objects modified by the application. It handles serialization to BSON for MongoDB storage and deserialization back to 'Event' objects, including migration and version handling. The class mainly focuses on converting event objects to BSON, migrating event data across versions, and interpreting JSON payloads related to events in the system.

classes.name: ThingMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: Implements an Akka EventAdapter for serializing and deserializing 'Event' objects to and from MongoDB BSON representations, including handling event version migration and JSON payload transformations.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Returns the type string of an event, used as a message manifest in Akka persistence.

methods.name: toJournal
methods.description: Serializes an Event object into a BSON format suitable for writing into the MongoDB event journal.

methods.name: fromJournal
methods.description: Deserializes a BSON event stored in the journal back into an Event object.

methods.name: tryToCreateEventFrom
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JSON representation of an event into an Event object, with error handling.

methods.name: createEventFrom
methods.description: Creates an Event from JSON, applying migrations and parsing via registry.

methods.name: migratePayload
methods.description: Migrates persisted event payloads to current schema version if needed.

methods.name: migrateId
methods.description: Updates event JSON objects to replace 'thing' identifiers to proper event type names.

methods.name: migrateComplex
methods.description: Applies specific migrations to JSON objects based on their 'ID' field to handle versioning.

methods.name: migrateModifiedToCreated
methods.description: Converts old 'modified' events with 'created' field true into 'created' events with updated type.

methods.name: renameField
methods.description: Helper to rename a field within a JSON object.

methods.name: renameJsonPointer
methods.description: Helper to rename a JSON pointer inside a JSON object.

methods.name: renameValue
methods.description: Helper to rename a value within a JSON object based on a field name.
